origin.description: The file-name extension, excluding the leading dot.
origin.details: Returns the extension, excluding the leading dot. Only purely alphanumeric extensions are recognized. The manual example lists files and does not call file_ext, so this page calls it.
origin.value: A character vector. An unrecognized extension is an empty string.

translation.description: The file-name extension, excluding the leading dot.

arguments.name: x
arguments.text: A path, or a list of paths. NULL and character(0) are None and an empty list.

translation.details: Returns the extension, excluding the leading dot. Only a trailing run of locale alphanumeric characters is recognized. The character class is libc iswalnum, which matches R's [[:alnum:]]. pathlib's suffix and str.isalnum() do not.
translation.value: A string, or a list of strings. An unrecognized extension is an empty string. NA stays NA.
